partners.mechanism_chain: DLG3 (HGNC:2850) —DISRUPTS→ postsynaptic density organization (GO:0031580); GRIN2B (HGNC:4470) —DISRUPTS→ regulation of NMDA receptor activity (GO:0010176); postsynaptic density organization (GO:0031580) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); postsynaptic density organization (GO:0031580) —LEADS_TO→ Developmental delay (HP:0001263); regulation of NMDA receptor activity (GO:0010176) —LEADS_TO→ Seizure (HP:0001250); regulation of NMDA receptor activity (GO:0010176) —LEADS_TO→ Developmental delay (HP:0001263).
